_about: Starter vocabulary (docs/SPEC.md Section 4) and starter library, copied into every new account at registration. Version 2, approved by Nathan on 17 November 2026: 227 exercises from an outside coach review of version 1, with 14 rest times made consistent with the default rule (120 s multi-joint, 90 s single-joint and core). Band exercises are bodyweight (Nathan, 17 November 2026), because band resistance is not standardized or labeled. See docs/STARTER_LIBRARY.md. Work seconds are 45 for every exercise; the rest and work defaults have no researched source yet.
